keys.description: Show runner and component update suggestions for bottles.

keys.description: Scan executables for malware patterns before running them.

keys.name: release-candidate

keys.description: Toggle Steam Proton prefixes support.

keys.description: Close Bottles after starting an executable from the file manager.

keys.name: audio-driver
keys.description: Select which Wine audio driver should be enforced for all bottles. Use "default" to leave the driver unchanged.

keys.name: disable-home-drive
keys.description: Do not expose the filesystem as the Z: drive in new bottles.

keys.name: show-sandbox-warning
keys.description: Toggle sandbox warning.

keys.description: When true, Bottles records playtime telemetry to a local SQLite database. Disable to stop tracking.

keys.description: How often to update session heartbeat. Defines max timestamp error for abrupt exits.

keys.name: eagle-scan-limit
keys.description: Maximum number of binaries to scan when analysing installers. Higher values provide more thorough analysis but take longer.

keys.name: show-funding
keys.description: Toggle the funding dialog.

keys.description: Use this UMU launcher instead of the system or bundled copy.
